Container.Name: clockspan
Container.Overview:
Clockspan is a self-hosted, single-day focus sheet for getting through a workday with ADHD. One page: a punch-style timeclock that works out when lunch is due and when the day ends, the few things that would make today a win, a focus timer that logs what you did, and a retrospective that puts the plan next to what happened. Every day is saved, and alarms fire as deadlines approach. It works on phones and installs to the Home Screen.
The default sign-in mode, none, has no login: use it on a LAN or behind your reverse proxy's own authentication. Pick local or oidc before you expose Clockspan to the internet.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: adhd timeclock punch clock focus timer pomodoro priorities time tracking

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Folder for the database (focus.db). The container takes ownership of it as PUID:PGID.

Config.Name: Sign-in mode
Config.Description: none: no sign-in (LAN, or behind your proxy's own auth). local: the first visit creates the admin account, and the admin adds users in Settings. oidc: sign in with Authentik or another OpenID Connect provider; needs App URL and the OIDC fields.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: Public URL of the app, e.g. https://focus.example.com. Required for oidc, and recommended whenever you reach the app through a domain. With https the session cookie is Secure and HSTS is on. Your provider's redirect URI must be this URL followed by /auth/callback.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Traefik): the number of proxies between the internet and the container, usually 1. Blank: none. Never true, which trusts any X-Forwarded-For a client sends and defeats the login rate limit.

Config.Name: Secure cookie
Config.Description: true or false forces the session cookie's Secure flag. Blank: Secure when App URL is https.

Config.Name: Keep days
Config.Description: Server-wide ceiling on history, in days (30 or more): every user's older days are deleted every few hours. Blank keeps everything; users can pick a shorter limit in Settings → Data.

Config.Name: OIDC issuer
Config.Description: For oidc. Authentik: Providers → your provider → OpenID Configuration Issuer.

Config.Name: OIDC client ID
Config.Description: For oidc: the client ID from your provider.

Config.Name: OIDC client secret
Config.Description: For oidc: the client secret from your provider.

Config.Name: OIDC scopes
Config.Description: For oidc: the scopes to request.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data folder and runs the app. 99 is Unraid's nobody; 0 keeps root.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for the same. 100 is Unraid's users.
